title: Comparison of low degree norms
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube with Fourier degree at most $k$, where $k\in\mathbb N$. For $1\le p\le 2$, its uniform norms satisfy $\|f\|_2\le e^{k(2/p-1)}\|f\|_p$.
hypotheses_covered: Real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
